task: Task 015: give every concurrently-rendering job its own SegmentPeekStrip/SegmentRenderMonitor row, mounted inside QueueItem.tsx instead of a single page-level strip in ActivityPage.tsx driven by the first active job found

frontend/src/utils/jobStatus.ts.summary: New file exporting the canonical ACTIVE_STATUSES set (queued/preparing/running/finalizing) — the single source of truth for 'is this job actively rendering' used to gate segment-level UI (peek strip / render monitor). Previously duplicated (and out of sync with QueueItem.tsx's separate isTrulyActive check, which also included 'processing') as a local const in ActivityPage.tsx.

frontend/src/pages/Activity/ActivityPage.summary: Removed the page-level activeJob selection (Object.values(jobs).find first-match), the useSegmentInventory call, the peek/expand/dismiss state (peekDismissed/monitorExpanded), the segment-retry handler, and the SegmentPeekStrip/SegmentRenderMonitor render block — all moved into QueueItem.tsx (per-row). Removed now-unused imports (api, useDevMode, useSegmentInventory, SegmentPeekStrip, SegmentRenderMonitor, isPeekStripDismissed/setPeekStripDismissed). Replaced the stale comment claiming tasks 010/011 already handled 'choosing among several' jobs (they didn't) with an accurate pointer to QueueItem.tsx. ActivityPageProps unchanged.

frontend/src/components/queue/QueueItem..summary: Added optional onRefresh prop (passed through from GlobalQueue) used by the new per-row segment-retry handler. Added per-row useSegmentInventory(devMode && isSegmentMonitorActive ? liveJob : null) call, isSegmentMonitorActive gate (ACTIVE_STATUSES.has(status) && chapterId present, imported from the new jobStatus.ts), peek/expand/dismiss local state (mirrors the prior ActivityPage.tsx logic, keyed on job.id via isPeekStripDismissed/setPeekStripDismissed), and mounts SegmentPeekStrip/SegmentRenderMonitor directly beneath the row's PredictiveProgressBar. Each QueueItem instance now owns an independent useSegmentInventory hydration and independent strip/monitor state — no shared state across rows.

frontend/src/components/queue/GlobalQueu.summary: Passes its existing onRefresh prop through to each QueueItem row (activeJobs.map) so per-row segment retry can re-pull job state. GlobalQueueProps unchanged.

frontend/tests/unit/components/queue/Que.summary: New test file proving the core fix: two concurrently-active jobs (different chapterIds) each render their own independently-hydrated SegmentPeekStrip/SegmentRenderMonitor with no cross-contamination; retrying a failed segment on one row calls api.generateSegments with only that row's segment id; a job outside ACTIVE_STATUSES renders neither and never calls api.fetchScriptView. Mocks only api.fetchScriptView/api.generateSegments (R2) — useSegmentInventory and QueueItem's own state run for real. Revert-checked: 2 of 3 tests fail against pre-fix QueueItem.tsx (only one page-level strip existed; no per-row retry button).

Moved/adapted from the retired frontend/tests/unit/pages/Activity/ActivityPagePeekStrip.test.tsx — same single-row scenarios (auto-appear at >=2 concurrently-rendering segments, inline expand, dismiss persistence via localStorage, re-surface on new failure despite a prior dismiss), now exercising QueueItem directly (mocking api.fetchScriptView instead of the ActivityPage-level useSegmentInventory mock) since that's where the behavior now lives.

frontend/tests/unit/pages/Activity/Activ.summary: Retired — its scenarios moved to frontend/tests/unit/components/queue/QueueItemPeekStrip.test.tsx now that ActivityPage.tsx no longer owns any per-job segment-monitor state.

flow_impact: Segment-level render monitoring is now genuinely per-job: N concurrently-rendering chapters each get their own strip/monitor row inside the GlobalQueue 'Processing Now' list, closing the gap flagged by Fable's Phase 2 sign-off (ActivityPage.tsx previously tracked exactly one 'active job'). No change to the backend contract, WebSocket events, or useSegmentInventory's public shape (task 016 already landed that fetch-dedupe fix, consumed here unmodified per-row).
